book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Makho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Yesuho Sabat bongonodec amna oburo omong fatfatyi tun orokogoc
Oro oipmonu Yesu yu Yuda nanohon fatmata yocyoc bucin ögoc. Öngga agocmai amna au oburo omong fatfatyi yu wocin idoc.
Tuna amna au yu Yesu mataho firing tantantha uyap dabigung. Yu ‘Yesu Sabat bongonodec amna wo tun orokontachu’ yongo igo dan togung.
Ihoroc tongga idiya Yesuho amna oburo omong fatfatyi inogoc, “Goc suraroho yangamin idongga iti.”

Ihoroc inuna idonguna Yesuho amna igo dan togungma inogoc, “Nongoruho tingting yac, non ogep Sabat bongonodec youp ogepma tontamontha woha youp wontucmuno tontamonthu? O ihorocgon non ogep Sabat bongonodec nucnoni tong ogep tong imontamontha woha non muyu yu dopnaya omaruthu nuhun?” Yesuho mata ihoroc inuna amna worocho mata mayi onggom songga idung.

Ihoroc idiya Yesu yu foring yangmuna kombigocmai yuhon irotno sop simbang foctogoc. Worocha tongga yu ec imuna amna oburo omong fatfatyi inogoc, “Goc obura tong nongnong toi!” Ihoroc inuna amna wo oburo tong nongnong tuna oburoho orokongdup togoc.
Tuna Farisi wo angga böc imu fauna king Heröthon toropniot suran tongga ‘Yesu yaö uyapdec wotnahamon’ yongo yong torop sigung.
Owi amna koböcma sinompho Yesu tan tonggung
Yesuot youp amnaniot yu ‘nonigon itna’ yongo böcsa wo imu fauna yamuc öngkoring tero onggung mahong Galili owi amna koböcmaho yu yan fonggung.

Yan fonggungma woi owi amna Yudia gurocinmahu o Yerusalem taundecmahu o Idumia gurocinmahu o owi amna guroc Yodan yamuc ökenne idocmahu o taun Tair orin Saidon worochon owi amna yu ambarac Yesuhon fatno moröma kombingga yuot ebung.

Ihoroc tuya yangga Yesuho youp amnani inogoc, “Owi amna nucno köreun köreun toup sinom tuya nochon bego angit maec. Worocha son girang obugu au tong arangarang tuya nocho wocin öantat,” ihoroc inogoc.
Yu owi amna koböcma sinom doun orokogungmaha owi amna obukocni yu ‘Yesu wotmöngga orokona’ yongo nucno köreun köreun toup sinom togung.
O ihorocgon owi amna dogu boyömoni yu Yesu angga goruc yemoc tong imongo mamboc morö tongga yogung, “Yaiöö, Yesu goc Kopotorochon Manano.”
Ihoroc yuya Yesuho ‘yu nochon foro yong fandat tongoninga’ yongo ‘muno’ orongi sinom inogoc.
Yesuho youp amnani 12 ihoroc soworegoc
Oro, Yesu yu sa urongodec öngmuna amna soworengga ino kombigocma yu inong yuna ebung.

Ehuya yu amna 12 ihoroc youpha soworengga aposel ma imogoc. Yesu yu ‘amna wo nocot kondonggon itongonahamon’ yongo o ihorocgon ‘nocho yu fiaya ongmuya fatmata ogepma owi amnadec yong silip tong imong tongonung’ yongo amna torop wo soworegoc.
Soworengga yu dogu boyömo dong yanyanthon gesö sing imogoc.
Oro amna 12 soworegocma yuhon ma torop wömai ingoroc: Saimon, yuhon mano auma wömai yu Pita ihoroc mambodoc.
O Sebedihon mananin yai Jems orin Jön. Yuhon mano au wömai yu Boanesis ihoroc mambodoc. Ma worochon foro woi undiphon mananin.
O amna au idungma manoi, Andru, Filip, Bartolomyu, Matyu, Tomas, o Alfiushon manano Jems, o ihorocgon Tadius, o Saimon yui Selothon toropdecma.
O Yudas Iskariot, yu wömai mit Yesu ayamihon oburodec sigoc. Amna torop wo wömai Yesuho ‘nochon youp amnanai idarut’ yongo soworegoc.
Amna auho Yesuha yogung, ‘yu dogu kopot Belsebulhon gesö sogitmuna youpno tongitac yo’
Oro, Yesu yu bucin öngga youp amnaniot nacno nocnocha kombigoc mahong owi amna koböcmaho engmuya böc foc tongdup tongga nacno nocnochon bego au maidoc.
Ihoroc tuya Yesuhon nip orugiho fat wo kombingga yogung, “Yesu yu bumbum yongga tac yo.” Ihoroc yongga yu ‘Yesu böcnon yangat tongona’ yongo ebung.

Tuna nongoru gendic fandat fandat amna au yu Yerusalem taundec engmuya Yesuha ingoroc yogung, “Dogu wontucmunohon morömo mano Belsebul yu amna ngorocdec idina dogu boyömo dong yanitac yo,” ihoroc yogung.
Ihoroc yuya Yesu mata wo kombingga owi amna inuna ehuya mata tepmo au ingoroc inogoc, “Dogu kopot yu wömai dogu kopot nucni madong yanitac.
O ihorocgon Kantri auho ficfuc tongga owi amna inohogon emoc tontanganu wömai kantri worocho obukontac.
O ihorocgon böcsa au yu ficfuc tongga böc morömpho inoha emoc tontanganu wömai gesöno ohongga makoing sic.
O worochon torocgon dogu kopotho inoin nucni ayam tontacanu wömai yu makoingsic, muno yuhon gesö bödeup.
Kombiarut, amna au yu amna koingoho bucin öngmuna manomanono usem toctocno wömai maec. Osuc wömai yu böc morömphon orung oburo feto singga mit wömai yu ogep manomanono yongo usem fongontac.
“Nocho boinno sinom kantiwa, Kopotoroc yu owi amnahon wontucmuno ambarac younfat imangoc. O owi amnaho Kopotorocha yong saha yongidangma worochon turongo ambarac younfat imangoc.

Wohong amna au yu Kunkun Yaruhon youpha yong samborec yontacma yuhon turongono wömai Kopotorocho mit maimunfat imic. Muno sinom, turongo worocho wömai mabödec bödecno öngahontu o mithontu woi tohong singimuna idimangoc.”
Oro Yesuho mata wo yogocma wömai nongoru gendic fandat fandat amnaho ‘dogu wontucmuno au yudec itac,’ ihoroc yongo yogungmaha yogoc.
Yesuhon macni orugi sinom woi numari
Oro Yesu mata ihoroc yongga idina urop macni orugi böcsa woce engkubung. Engkungga böc amante ida ‘Yesu epun’ yongo mata siuya bucin ögoc.
Mata siuya owi amna bucin idungma yu Yesu inogung, “Macai, oröcai yu engmuya gocha yang.”
Ihoroc inuya Yesuho mata ökene ingoroc iban imogoc, “Nochon macnai oröcnai woi numari?”
Ihoroc yongmuna daroho owi amna yuot arenggumbec tongga idungma wo foring yangmuna yogoc, “Nochon macnai, oröcnai, woi woroc son ngo idangma.
Owi amna ambaracho Kopotorochon irot kombic kombic tanidangma yu wömai nochon oröcnai, natnai, macnai sinom idang.” Yesu yu ihoroc yogoc.
